notice: No raw comparative benchmark runs have been published. Targets are not measured results or guarantees.

methodology.dataset: Use consented or synthetic handles with independently checked positive and negative ground truth. Publish platform coverage and unknown outcomes separately.
methodology.false_positive_rate: FP / (FP + TN), evaluated only on ground-truth negatives with definitive outcomes. Publish exclusions and unknown-negative counts.
methodology.accuracy: (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN), evaluated on definitive outcomes. Publish unknown and unchecked counts separately.
methodology.timing: Repeat the same dataset, scope, network and configuration for each tool. Report p50 and p95 wall-clock duration, cold or warm cache state, timeouts and provider limits.
